scenario: a D2C subscription box service tracking renewal and churn
title: Dormant High-Value Subscribers with No Recent Activity
prompt: You are analyzing a D2C subscription box service. You have a subscribers table storing each subscriber's current loyalty points and a shipments table recording every shipment date. Identify subscribers who have accumulated at least 500 loyalty points AND have received no shipments on or after 2024-10-01. For each qualifying subscriber, report their subscriber_id, full_name (cleaned and formatted), signup_date_text (converted to a proper date), points balance, total shipment count (all-time, even shipments before the cutoff), preferred_categories array, primary_category (the first category in the array), month of signup, and whether their points balance is odd or even. Output only those subscribers who meet both the points threshold and the recency exclusion.
schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE subscribers (subscriber_id INT PRIMARY KEY, full_name VARCHAR(100), signup_date_text VARCHAR(20), points INT, preferred_categories TEXT[]); CREATE TABLE shipments (shipment_id INT PRIMARY KEY, subscriber_id INT, shipment_date DATE);
answer_key: SELECT s.subscriber_id, INITCAP(TRIM(s.full_name)) AS full_name, TO_DATE(s.signup_date_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS signup_date, s.points, COUNT(sh.shipment_id) AS total_shipments, s.preferred_categories, s.preferred_categories[1] AS primary_category, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(s.signup_date_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS signup_month, CASE WHEN MOD(s.points, 2) = 0 THEN 'even' ELSE 'odd' END AS points_parity FROM subscribers s LEFT JOIN shipments sh ON s.subscriber_id = sh.subscriber_id WHERE s.points >= 500 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments sh2 WHERE sh2.subscriber_id = s.subscriber_id AND sh2.shipment_date >= DATE '2024-10-01') GROUP BY s.subscriber_id, s.full_name, s.signup_date_text, s.points, s.preferred_categories ORDER BY s.subscriber_id;
user_solution:
/* 
Filter: Only subscribers with at least 500 loyalty points and no shipments on or after 2024-10-01 are included.
*/

WITH total_shipments AS (
    SELECT
        s.subscriber_id,
        COUNT(h.shipment_id) AS total_shipments
    FROM shipments AS h
    JOIN subscribers AS s
        ON s.subscriber_id = h.subscriber_id
    WHERE h.shipment_date::date < '2024-10-01' AND s.points >= 500
    GROUP BY s.subscriber_id
)
SELECT
    subscriber_id,
    INITCAP(TRIM(full_name)) AS full_name,
    TO_CHAR(TRIM(signup_date_text)::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS signup_date,
    points,
    t.total_shipments,
    preferred_categories,
    preferred_categories[1] AS primary_category,
    EXTRACT('month' from TRIM(signup_date_text)::date) AS signup_month,
    CASE WHEN MOD(points, 2) = 0 THEN 'even' ELSE 'odd' END AS points_parity
FROM subscribers AS s
JOIN total_shipments AS t
USING (subscriber_id)
WHERE points >= 500
ORDER BY 1;
